Container.Name: AbuseBox-Backend
Container.Overview:
The AbuseBox API. Install this first, then install AbuseBox-Frontend and point its BACKEND_URL at this container.
AbuseBox is self-hosted monitoring for the IPs and domains you run: 24 DNS blacklists, SSL and domain expiry, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and uptime, with an alert when something changes.
On the first start an admin password is generated, printed in this container's log and saved as 'initial_admin_password' in the data path below.
Note on blacklists: Spamhaus and some other lists refuse queries that come through public resolvers such as Google or Cloudflare, and AbuseBox then shows "No answer" instead of a false "clean". Leave DNSBL_NAMESERVERS empty to use Unraid's own resolver, or set it to a resolver you run. See the README section "Blacklists that show No answer".
Container.Requires: Install AbuseBox-Frontend as well; on its own this container serves only the API.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: The API port. The frontend container connects to it, and scripts on this machine can use it directly.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database, the generated secret key and the initial admin password. Back this up.

Config.Name: Allowed browser origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated origins the UI is opened from, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000 . Must match the address you use to reach the frontend, or the browser blocks the API calls.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Username of the admin account created on the first start.

Config.Name: Admin email
Config.Description: Email address of that admin account. Alerts for an asset go to the email of the user who owns it.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Leave empty to have one generated on the first start, printed in the log and saved as 'initial_admin_password' in the data path.

Config.Name: App secret key
Config.Description: Signs login tokens. Leave empty to have one generated and saved in the data path.

Config.Name: Blacklist resolvers
Config.Description: Comma-separated DNS resolvers for blacklist lookups. Empty uses this server's own resolver. Public resolvers such as 8.8.8.8 are refused by Spamhaus.

Config.Name: Check interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often monitored assets are re-checked. Can also be changed in Settings.

Config.Name: WHOIS timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: How long to wait for a WHOIS server. Registries that throttle can take well over 10 seconds.

Config.Name: WHOIS cache (minutes)
Config.Description: How long a successful WHOIS answer is reused before asking the registry again. 0 disables caching.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Optional. SMTP server for email alerts.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: 587 uses STARTTLS; 465 uses TLS from the start.

Config.Name: SMTP from address
Config.Description: Optional. The From address on alert emails.

Config.Name: Webhook URL
Config.Description: Optional. Slack and Discord URLs get chat messages. A URL set in Settings takes precedence.
